review_improvement: Prevents a guessed eye command from erasing a critical 10,000-reset procedure and prevents indiscriminate all-bridge disruption.
independent_technical_reasoning: A secondary-bus reset affects every function below the bridge and can remove storage or management connectivity. Repeating it 10,000 times multiplies cumulative recovery risk, so physical topology exclusions and per-cycle state checks are indispensable before any automation.
